SASBDB entry SASDWJ4  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDWJ4/)

Publication: Crystal structure of the class V GTP-binding RNA aptamer bound to its ligand: GTP recognition by a topologically complex intermolecular G-quadruplex.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaf1315

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDWJ4/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
